headline: Ghana Annual Inflation Rises to 5.5% in October
summary: Ghana's year-on-year inflation rate increased to 5.5% in October 2026 from 5.2% in September, marking the third consecutive monthly rise driven primarily by non-food inflation.
why: Inflation metrics are critical for central banks when evaluating price stability and determining monetary policy trajectories.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Rising inflation trends increase purchasing power pressures and influence monetary policy decisions.
